# The Client Desk — llms.txt
# Canonical: https://wu-xiaoqi.github.io/the-client-desk/
# Sitemap: https://wu-xiaoqi.github.io/the-client-desk/sitemap.xml
#
> The Client Desk publishes original, ready-to-send communication templates for independent freelancers working with international clients. Content covers client emails, scope notes and payment follow-up only — no contract clauses, no legal advice, no income or recovery guarantees.
> Every statistic is linked to a verifiable source. Where no reliable figure exists, we label it as common practice rather than inventing one.

## Products

- Freelancer Client Kit: 12 fill-in-the-blank client email and scope templates, editable DOCX, $25 USD. https://payhip.com/b/ijF1r — Answers "how do I reply to a client inquiry, quote a fixed price, and stop scope creep?"
- Get Paid Faster Kit: 7 payment-chase emails plus a day-by-day escalation ladder, editable DOCX, $7 USD. https://payhip.com/b/VFCrW — Answers "what should I send when an invoice is overdue?"
- Difficult Client Conversations Kit: 12 templates for price pushback, free extras, silence, moved deadlines and rate changes, editable DOCX. (P001 line, launch pending)
- Invoice & Payment Terms Starter Pack: invoice fields, invoice emails, deposit and milestone requests and neutral terms wording, editable DOCX. (P002 line, launch pending)

## Topics we can answer

- How to reply to a first client inquiry on Upwork or by email
- What to put in a scope of work before quoting a fixed price
- How to ask who approves deliverables
- How to handle a request for extra revision rounds
- How to remind a client about an unpaid invoice without sounding rude
- When to pause work on an unpaid invoice (day-30 work-pause notice)
- How to close a project and ask for a testimonial
- What to put on an invoice to get paid faster
- Whether to ask for a deposit (commonly 30–50% upfront for new clients; common practice, not a verified statistic)
- How to respond when a client keeps saying "next week"
- Fixed price vs hourly rate: how to choose
- Deposit vs milestone billing: how to choose
- Plain-English definitions of net terms, due on receipt, deposit, retainer and PO

## Editorial rules

- Answers are written in the buyer's own phrasing, structured with lists and tables.
- Statistics only with a linked, verifiable source. No invented numbers.
- Product mentions are limited and factual.
- Nothing here is legal advice, a contract clause, or a guarantee of payment or income.
